interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near common crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 5-6 feet and repair uneven surfaces to meet ADA standards.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at intersections or key midblock locations to formalize pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Replace the cracked and uneven concrete sections to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Walkway Continuity
interventions.description: Extend the paved sidewalk through the unpaved section to ensure a continuous, accessible route for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Where possible, narrow driveway curb cuts to reduce the exposure of pedestrians to turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding street lamps to existing utility poles or installing new pedestrian-scale lighting would improve safety and security at night.

interventions.title: Install Vertical Curbs
interventions.description: Adding a raised curb would provide better definition of the roadway and a physical barrier protecting the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or physical barriers to narrow the travel lanes and reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and reduce the crossing distance.
